{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Satin blouse, classic fit collar, elbow length, midnight blue (#000080), silk.
Wide-leg trousers, tapered at the ankle, floor length, charcoal grey (#36454F), wool crepe.
Structured blazer, single-breasted with peak lapels, hip length, black (#000000), gabardine.
Ankle boots, pointed toe with a moderate heel, glossy leather finish, black (#000000), calf leather.
Simple gold hoop earrings, polished metal, medium diameter, 18k gold plated, brass.
Delicate chain necklace, minimal link design, silver tone, sterling silver plated, stainless steel.

This outfit honors her wish for a restrained and classic look by pairing a timeless blazer and tailored trousers with elegant satin fabric that catches the club's artificial light without appearing flashy. The dark color palette of midnight blue, charcoal, and black ensures she stands out with sophistication rather than distraction in the crowd while dancing or standing for long periods. The structured silhouette provides necessary support and confidence for an evening at a rock concert, balancing her desire for formality with the high-energy environment. Finally, the pointed toe ankle boots offer stability on the dance floor while maintaining the smart dress code she specified."}
